findings.finding: The sole regression test for the reviewer Chat pre-auth gate is not wired into any normal CI test command. `vitest.config.ts` only discovers tests/unit and src TypeScript tests; `package.json` `test:focused-acceptance` omits this file; the explicit browser Node test list in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` also omits it. I confirmed `pnpm exec vitest list tests/browser/member-pre-auth-resource-boundary.test.mjs` does not discover it.
findings.why_it_matters: Removing the Chat `requireResourceHealth()` call would leave all configured CI green because the current Settings auth test and generic resource-boundary test do not exercise the reviewer Chat source prefix. The acceptance safety contract could regress silently.
findings.recommendation: Wire this exact test into a normal CI Node test command before integration/push, then rerun that configured command.

positive_quality_evidence: The new test runs the actual source prefix and its operation-order assertion fails against an isolated pre-change copy, so it guards behavior rather than only checking for a token in source.
The resource-health call uses the existing canonical boundary; no new counters, thresholds, deadlines, or ownership rules were added.
The existing Settings auth test is in the explicit CI node:test list, and the canonical native resource boundary is in focused acceptance CI.
